responsibility: Specializes the PA target for the 64-bit HP runtime data model by overriding core ABI properties rather than instruction patterns. It defines fundamental type sizes and signedness to match PA64 system headers, changes varargs padding and argument growth conventions for the 64-bit runtime, and selects secondary-memory behavior for transfers between general and floating-point registers, so the generic PA backend in pa.cc/pa.h follows the correct 64-bit calling and data-layout ABI.
